display.longDescription: 安装 Ubuntu apt 源里的 PCManFM，用来验证 Kite 的 SH/终端请求式 X11 渲染链路，也可作为轻量文件管理器使用。

requirementRows.label: 显示能力
requirementRows.value: SH 请求 Kite 内嵌 X11

install.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '当前实例缺少 apt-get，无法安装 PCManFM'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p "$install_root" /workspace/.kf/runtime/pcmanfm-x11
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y pcmanfm dbus-x11 shared-mime-info xdg-utils adwaita-icon-theme fonts-dejavu-core
test -x /usr/bin/pcmanfm
pcmanfm --version || true
echo 'PCManFM installed for Kite embedded X11'

recipe.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v pcmanfm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PCManFM 还没有安装完整，请先点获取或重新获取。'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/runtime/pcmanfm-x11
proxy="${KITE_DESKTOP_PROXY:-/workspace/.kf/bin/kite-open-desktop}"
if [ ! -x "$proxy" ]; then echo 'Kite X11 桌面代理不可用，请重新打开实例。'; exit 127; fi
desktop_cmd="if command -v dbus-launch >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec dbus-launch --exit-with-session pcmanfm --no-desktop /workspace; else exec pcmanfm --no-desktop /workspace; fi"
"$proxy" "$desktop_cmd"
